# Creative Tim x402 Resources

Pay-per-request API and content protected by the [x402 Protocol](https://www.x402.org/).

## Resources

- **Message** (`/api/message`) – Simple paid message API
- **UI/UX Book** (`/api/ui-ux-book`) – Access to Roots of UI/UX Design Book and resources
- **ShadCN Block** (`/api/shadcn-block`) – ShadCN UI component blocks (query param: `block_name`, e.g. `testimonials-02`)

## Discovery

Full X402 v2 discovery (accepts, resource, extensions): `GET https://x402.creative-tim.com/api`
